question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of (?) will logically complete the series.

solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) All the element shift anticlockwise subsequently.

2) Top left corner element is replaced by new element subsequently.

3) Bottom left corner element is shaded subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be3b3858fadeab35c89eb8a2053f536737a13716893c2f257e78008fb1b8e8d9.png] 

Thus, final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1cc23d36451425d15bbd30bb217e1936241dad02043310c1b922273a42fafbf.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
